foldable_bicycles.peak_hour_rule: Foldable bicycles are NOT permitted during peak hours even if folded.
foldable_bicycles.placement: Passenger is responsible for keeping the bicycle with them and must not block aisles or doors.

standard_bicycles.reason: Standard (non-foldable) bicycles are not permitted on the metro at any time.

electric_scooters.reason: E-scooters and hoverboards are prohibited on all metro services due to fire safety regulations, even if folded or switched off.

luggage.oversized_peak_rule: Items exceeding the size limit are not permitted during peak hours (07:00-09:30 and 17:00-20:00 weekdays).
luggage.placement: All luggage must be held by the passenger or placed in the luggage area at the ends of the carriage. Luggage must not block seats, aisles, or doors.

pets.conditions: Small pets in fully enclosed hard or soft carriers only.
pets.seat_occupancy: Pets must not occupy a seat.
pets.exceptions: Guide dogs and registered assistance animals are permitted at all times without a carrier.
pets.prohibited: Dogs not in carriers are not permitted on the metro, including on leads.

food_and_drink.eating: Eating is discouraged on the metro. Passengers must not leave litter.
food_and_drink.alcohol: Alcohol consumption is not permitted on metro services or at stations.

priority_seating.description: Seats marked with a yellow priority sign are reserved for elderly passengers (65+), pregnant women, passengers with disabilities, and passengers travelling with young children.
priority_seating.rule: All other passengers must vacate priority seats immediately when requested.

accessibility.wheelchair_access: All metro stations are equipped with lifts and ramps. Passengers in wheelchairs may board at any door.
accessibility.assisted_boarding: Station staff are available to assist passengers with boarding. Please approach the station information desk.
accessibility.audio_visual_announcements: All metro trains and stations provide both audio and visual announcements for stops, connections, and service updates.
accessibility.tactile_paving: Tactile guidance paving is installed on all platforms to assist visually impaired passengers.

prohibited_items: Items emitting strong odours that may cause discomfort to other passengers
metro.smoking_and_vaping: Strictly prohibited on all metro carriages, platforms, and station concourses.
metro.noise: Passengers are asked to keep noise to a considerate level. Use of personal audio devices with external speakers is not permitted.

foldable_bicycles.placement: Must be stored in the overhead rack or in the space at the end of the carriage.

standard_bicycles.conditions: Standard bicycles are permitted in designated bicycle bays only. Maximum 2 bicycles per train.
standard_bicycles.peak_hour_rule: Standard bicycles are NOT permitted on national rail services during peak hours.
standard_bicycles.booking: Bicycle spaces are first-come-first-served and cannot be reserved in advance. Fee is payable at the platform bicycle bay gate.
standard_bicycles.placement: Bicycles must be placed in the designated bicycle bay. Passengers remain responsible for their bicycle.

electric_scooters.reason: E-scooters and hoverboards are not permitted on national rail services.

luggage.overhead_rack: Items must fit in the overhead luggage rack above seats. No formal size restriction, but items must not cause inconvenience to other passengers.
luggage.large_items: Oversized items such as large suitcases should be placed in the dedicated luggage areas at the ends of each carriage.
luggage.notes: Passengers are responsible for their own luggage at all times. The operator is not liable for lost or damaged luggage.

pets.guide_and_assistance_dogs: Permitted at all times in all coaches at no charge.

other_dogs.conditions: Dogs must be on a lead at all times. Permitted in standard class coaches only.

small_animals_in_carriers.conditions: Small animals in enclosed carriers permitted in standard class. Not permitted in first class coaches.

food_and_drink.general: Food and drink are permitted in all coaches.
food_and_drink.trolley_service: A refreshment trolley operates on selected services. Check the service schedule for availability.
food_and_drink.alcohol: Alcohol is permitted in moderation. Passengers behaving disruptively due to alcohol may be asked to leave the train.
food_and_drink.first_class: Complimentary beverages are not provided. Passengers may bring their own food and drink.

quiet_zones.description: Selected standard class carriages are designated quiet zones. Phone calls, loud music, and disruptive noise are not permitted in quiet zones.
quiet_zones.identification: Quiet zone carriages are marked with a quiet zone symbol on the door and inside the carriage.
quiet_zones.rule: Passengers should check carriage markings before boarding if a quiet journey is preferred.

priority_seating.description: Dedicated priority seats are available in all coaches, marked with a blue priority sign.
priority_seating.rule: Priority seats are reserved for elderly passengers (65+), pregnant women, passengers with disabilities, and passengers travelling with young children. Other passengers must vacate on request.

accessibility.wheelchair_access: All national rail stations are wheelchair accessible. Ramps are available on request from platform staff.
accessibility.assisted_boarding: Passengers requiring assistance should contact customer service at least 24 hours before travel.
accessibility.priority_boarding: Passengers with mobility difficulties are welcome to board first. Please inform platform staff.

prohibited_items: Items emitting strong odours that may cause discomfort to other passengers
national_rail.smoking_and_vaping: Strictly prohibited on all train carriages and at all station platforms.
national_rail.conduct: Passengers behaving in a manner that causes distress or danger to other passengers or staff may be removed from the train. In serious cases, the operator reserves the right to involve law enforcement.

reporting.how_to_report: Lost property can be reported via the app, website, or by contacting customer service within 24 hours of travel.

collection.location: Lost items found on trains or at stations are held at the nearest staffed station for up to 7 days.
collection.collection_hours: Monday to Friday 08:00-18:00, Saturday 09:00-16:00. Closed Sundays.
collection.id_description: Valid photo ID and booking reference required to collect lost property.

lost_property.unclaimed_items: Items not collected within 7 days are transferred to the central lost property office and held for a further 28 days before disposal.
lost_property.valuables: High-value items such as electronics, jewellery, and documents are logged separately and held securely. Passengers are encouraged to report these immediately.
lost_property.liability: The operator is not liable for lost, stolen, or damaged personal belongings. Passengers are advised to keep valuables with them at all times.

engineering_works.advance_notice: Planned engineering works are announced at least 7 days in advance via the app, website, and station notices.
engineering_works.replacement_services: Rail replacement bus services operate between affected stations during planned engineering works. Journey times will be longer than usual.
engineering_works.refund_eligibility: Passengers holding valid tickets for services cancelled due to planned engineering works are entitled to a full refund or free rebooking on an alternative service.
engineering_works.how_to_claim: Refunds for engineering works cancellations can be claimed via the app or customer service within 28 days.

unplanned_disruptions.real_time_updates: Live service updates are available in the app and on platform information boards.
unplanned_disruptions.delay_threshold_for_notification: Passengers are notified via app push notification if their booked service is delayed by 15 minutes or more.
unplanned_disruptions.alternative_routing: When a service is severely delayed or cancelled, passengers may travel on the next available service on the same route at no extra charge.
unplanned_disruptions.compensation: Delay compensation is governed by policy RF005.

penalty_fares.description: Passengers must travel with a valid ticket for their entire journey. Failure to produce a valid ticket upon request will result in a penalty fare.
penalty_fares.metro_penalty: A flat penalty fare of $50 is applied for travelling without a valid ticket on the metro network.
penalty_fares.national_rail_penalty: The penalty fare on national rail services is $100 or twice the full single fare applicable to the journey made, whichever is greater.
penalty_fares.appeals: Penalty fares can be appealed within 21 days via the official website. Appeals must include evidence of ticket purchase or a valid reason for inability to purchase.

group_bookings.conditions: All members of the group must travel together on the same designated train. Group bookings cannot be modified or refunded within 7 days of travel.
group_bookings.how_to_book: Group bookings must be made at least 14 days in advance through the group travel portal on the website or by calling customer service.

metro.under_5: Free of charge. No ticket required.
metro.ages_5_to_15: Half the adult fare. A child ticket must be purchased.
metro.unaccompanied_children: Children under 10 must be accompanied by a person aged 16 or over.

national_rail.under_5: Free of charge when accompanied by a fare-paying adult.
national_rail.ages_5_to_15: Half the adult fare applies to standard and first class.
national_rail.family_railcard: Passengers holding a valid Family Railcard receive an additional 33% discount on child fares and 20% discount on adult fares for up to 4 adults and 4 children travelling together.

prams_and_pushchairs.metro: Foldable pushchairs are permitted at all times. Unfolded pushchairs are permitted outside peak hours only (outside 07:00-09:30 and 17:00-20:00 weekdays). Passengers must fold pushchairs if the carriage is crowded.
prams_and_pushchairs.national_rail: Pushchairs and prams are permitted in all coaches. Dedicated space is available in the family coach. Passengers are responsible for securing pushchairs.

family_coach.description: Selected national rail services include a designated family coach where children and families are welcome. Noise levels are expected to be higher in this coach.
family_coach.facilities: The family coach includes extra luggage space, fold-down tables, and proximity to accessible toilets.

passenger_conduct.general_behaviour: All passengers are expected to behave in a manner that is respectful to other passengers and staff. Aggressive, threatening, or antisocial behaviour will not be tolerated.
passenger_conduct.staff_interactions: Passengers must comply with reasonable instructions from authorised staff. Obstructing or abusing staff is a criminal offence.
passenger_conduct.photography: Photography for personal use is permitted on trains and at stations. Commercial photography requires prior written permission from the operator.
passenger_conduct.busking: Busking and street performance are not permitted on trains or at stations without prior written authorisation.

intoxication.metro: Passengers who are visibly intoxicated may be refused travel. Alcohol consumption is prohibited on all metro services.
intoxication.national_rail: Passengers who are visibly intoxicated and causing a disturbance may be asked to leave the train. The operator reserves the right to contact law enforcement.

passenger_conduct.mobile_phones: Passengers are asked to use mobile phones considerately, particularly in quiet zones and priority seating areas. Loud speakerphone use is discouraged in all coaches.

metro_day_pass.validity: Unlimited travel on all metro lines from first use until end of service on the same day.
metro_day_pass.purchase: Available via the app, ticket machines at all stations, or customer service desks.

metro_weekly_pass.validity: 7 consecutive days of unlimited metro travel from the date of activation.
metro_weekly_pass.purchase: Available via the app or at staffed station desks.

national_rail_monthly_pass.validity: Unlimited standard class travel on any national rail service within a single zone for 30 days.
national_rail_monthly_pass.zones: Zone maps are available on the website and at all staffed stations.
national_rail_monthly_pass.first_class_upgrade: Monthly pass holders may upgrade to first class on a per-journey basis by paying the first class supplement at the time of travel.

combined_metro_rail_pass.validity: 7 consecutive days of unlimited travel on both metro and national rail services within the covered network.
combined_metro_rail_pass.purchase: Available via the app or at staffed national rail stations only.

metro.lines_covered: Night services operate on Lines 1, 2, and 3 only. Other lines do not operate between 00:30 and 05:30.
metro.fares: Standard fares apply. Day passes and weekly passes are valid on night services.

national_rail.note: National rail does not currently operate overnight services. First departures begin at approximately 05:30.

express_services.description: Selected national rail routes operate express services that skip intermediate stops. Express services are clearly marked in the timetable and on platform displays.
express_services.booking: Express surcharge must be paid at the time of booking. Passengers holding standard tickets may not board express services without paying the surcharge.

charter_services.description: Entire train carriages or trains can be chartered for private events, corporate travel, or group excursions.
charter_services.how_to_book: Contact the group and charter travel team via the website or by phone. A non-refundable deposit of 25% is required at the time of booking.
